questions.question: What was the main objective of the UPI-UPU Integration project unveiled by Union Minister Jyotiraditya M. Scindia?

options.text: To expand India’s postal network globally
To transform cross-border remittances and expand financial inclusion worldwide
To create a new postal currency system
To enhance India’s digital banking infrastructure

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To transform cross-border remittances and expand financial inclusion worldwide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister Jyotiraditya M. Scindia unveiled the UPI-UPU Integration project at the 28th Universal Postal Congress, aiming to transform cross-border remittances and expand financial inclusion globally.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The UPI-UPU Integration project aims to make cross-border remittances faster, cheaper, and more secure by combining India’s UPI with the UPU Interconnection Platform.**
 
• This initiative allows families across borders to transfer money instantly, securely, and at lower costs.
 
• It will also strengthen the role of postal administrations by offering new revenue streams and reinforcing their community service role.
 
• India’s commitment to reducing global remittance costs aligns with the UN Sustainable Development Goal of reducing remittance fees to below 3 percent by 2030.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UPI (Unified Payments Interface)__

 __
 
• A real-time payment solution developed by NPCI, India, which processed over 185 billion transactions worth USD 2.83 trillion in 2024–25.
 
 
 
• UPU Interconnection Platform__
 __
 
• A platform that connects postal networks globally, facilitating cross-border communication and transactions.
 
 
 
• UN Sustainable Development Goal__
 __
 
• A global goal aiming to reduce remittance costs to below 3 percent by 2030 to promote economic inclusion.
 
 
 
• India Post Payments Bank__
 
 
• Part of India’s financial inclusion model, helping millions of Indians, especially women, to access banking services.

questions.question: India has been re-elected as the Vice-Chairperson of the Asia-Pacific Bureau (Group IV) at which session of the International Convention against Doping in Sport?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**COP10.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India has been re-elected as the Vice-Chairperson of the Bureau for the Asia-Pacific (Group IV) at the 10th Session of the Conference of Parties (COP10) to the International Convention against Doping in Sport, held at UNESCO Headquarters in Paris from October 20–22, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The COP10 meeting marked the 20th anniversary of the Anti-Doping Convention and was attended by over 500 delegates from 190+ States Parties and international organizations.**
 
• **India’s re-election highlights its continued leadership in the global fight against doping in sports, alongside its role in strengthening international anti-doping cooperation.**
 
• **The Indian delegation, led by Sports Secretary Hari Ranjan Rao and NADA Director General Anant Kumar, engaged with stakeholders such as the African Union, IOC, and WADA to enhance global anti-doping efforts.**
 
• **India contributed interactive displays showcasing the progress and impact of the Anti-Doping Convention during the proceedings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Convention against Doping in Sport**__

 __
 
• Adopted by UNESCO in 2005 to promote fair play, ethics, and integrity in sport by preventing doping.
 
• Sets global standards for anti-doping efforts, ensuring that athletes compete in a level playing field.
 
 
 
• **Key Participants**__
 __
 
• **Azerbaijan:** Elected as Chairperson of COP10 Bureau.
 
• **Brazil, Zambia, Saudi Arabia:** Elected as Vice-Chairs representing their respective regional groups.
 
 
 
• **India’s Role and Contributions**__
 __
 
• India’s leadership at COP10 emphasizes its commitment to ensuring transparency and fairness in global sports.
 
• India’s proposed amendments in the form of the Values Education through Sport (VETS) approach aim to instill ethics, integrity, and fair play, focusing on youth and sports organizations.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Addressed at COP10**__
 
 
• Discussions focused on new challenges like gene manipulation, traditional pharmacopoeia, and ethical concerns in sports.
 
• The session also addressed governance reforms and financing the Fund for the Elimination of Doping in Sport.

questions.question: Which city in Myanmar was most affected by the devastating earthquake in March 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandalay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mandalay** is the **second-largest city** in Myanmar and a major cultural and economic hub.
 
• It is located in the central part of the country, on the **eastern bank of the Irrawaddy River**.
 
• The city is known for its **rich history, religious heritage**, and numerous **Buddhist monasteries and pagodas**.
 
• In March 2025, Mandalay was most affected by the devastating earthquake due to its location near a **tectonic fault line** and its dense population.
 
• The earthquake caused significant damage to infrastructure, including **residential buildings, religious sites**, and **public amenities**.
 
• The proximity of Mandalay to the **Sagaing Fault**, one of the most active fault lines in Myanmar, increases its vulnerability to earthquakes.
 
• The government and international organizations initiated **rescue and relief operations** to assist the affected population in Mandalay.
 
• Efforts were made to assess the **seismic risks** and improve the city's infrastructure to withstand future earthquakes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bago**__

 __
 
• **Bago** is located in the southern part of Myanmar and is known for its **agriculture** and **Buddhist sites**.
 
• While it is prone to natural disasters like floods and cyclones, it was not the most affected city during the March 2025 earthquake.
 
 
 
• **Yangon**__
 __
 
• **Yangon** is the largest city in Myanmar and its former capital.
 
• It is an important **economic and cultural center**, but it was not the epicenter of the March 2025 earthquake.
 
 
 
• **Naypyidaw**__
 
 
• **Naypyidaw** is the current capital of Myanmar, known for its **planned city layout** and **spacious infrastructure**.
 
• Although it is located inland, it experienced less damage in the March 2025 earthquake compared to Mandalay.

questions.question: Which two companies have partnered to set up a Rs 6,000 crore hydroelectric project in Bhutan?

options.text: Tata Power and Druk Green Power
Adani Power and Druk Green Power

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Adani Power and Druk Green Power.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Adani Power and Bhutan’s state-owned Druk Green Power Corp Ltd have signed a pact to set up a 570 MW hydroelectric project in Bhutan.**
 
• **The project will be developed under the BOOT (Build, Own, Operate, Transfer) model, with a total investment of Rs 6,000 crore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The hydroelectric project is called the Wangchhu peaking run-of-river hydro project.**
 
• **A power purchase agreement and a concession agreement were signed during the ceremony.**
 
• **The agreements were signed in the presence of Bhutan’s Prime Minister, Dasho Tshering Tobgay, and Gautam Adani, Chairman of Adani Group.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the BOOT Model**__

 __
 
• BOOT stands for Build, Own, Operate, Transfer, a model where the developer builds and operates the project for a period before transferring ownership to the host government.
 
 
 
• **About the Project**__
 __
 
• The project will provide power and support infrastructure development in Bhutan, which is known for its hydropower potential.
 
 
 
• **Key Figures**__
 
 
• Bhutan’s Prime Minister, Dasho Tshering Tobgay, and Adani Group’s Gautam Adani were present at the signing ceremony.

questions.question: For which term has India been elected unopposed to the UN Human Rights Council starting 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India has been elected **unopposed** to the **UN Human Rights Council** for the **seventh time**, for a three-year term (2026-2028) starting next year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Human Rights Council is an intergovernmental body within the **United Nations** with 47 member countries.
 
• It promotes and protects **human rights globally**, reviews situations in member countries, and provides a forum for discussion.
 
• India was first elected to the Council in 2006 and has now secured its **seventh term**.
 
• Each member serves a **three-year term**, with membership limited to two consecutive terms at a time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Formation**__: The Council was formed in 2006, replacing the former UN Commission on Human Rights.
 
• __**Elections**__: Seats are distributed among five UN regional groups, with one-third renewed annually.
 
• __**Functions**__: Reviews human rights situations, protects rights, and facilitates international dialogue.
 
• __**Membership Terms**__: Members can serve a maximum of two consecutive three-year terms.

questions.question: Which strategic initiative was proposed by Russia to boost agriculture trade among BRICS countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**BRICS Grain Exchange.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India and Russia discussed plans to create a common agricultural food exchange, the BRICS Grain Exchange, to boost agriculture trade among BRICS member countries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The BRICS Grain Exchange was proposed at the 2024 BRICS Summit in Kazan and endorsed in the Kazan Declaration as a fair and transparent agricultural trading system.**
 
• **The exchange aims to create a new pricing index, establishing independent benchmarks for grain pricing and reducing reliance on Western exchanges like the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME).**
 
• **It facilitates trade in national currencies, reducing dependence on the U.S. dollar and enabling smoother transactions among member countries.**
 
• **The initiative is intended to enhance food security by creating a more resilient and reliable supply chain for BRICS members and other countries in the Global South.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• BRICS Grain Exchange__

 __
 
• A proposed platform for trading grains among BRICS nations to ensure fair pricing, reduce dependency on U.S. dollars, and strengthen food security.
 
 
 
• Pricing Index__
 __
 
• The exchange will establish independent benchmarks for grain pricing to counter the influence of Western exchanges where prices are often set in U.S. dollars.
 
 
 
• Trade in National Currencies__
 __
 
• Member countries can settle grain trade in their own currencies, enhancing financial autonomy and reducing foreign exchange risk.
 
 
 
• Food Security Impact__
 
 
• The initiative aims to create a resilient supply chain, benefiting BRICS members and the Global South by ensuring stable access to essential grains.

questions.question: What is the focus of the India-UK Connectivity & Innovation Centre launched in October 2025?

options.text: AI in telecom, non-terrestrial networks, and telecom cybersecurity
Internet of Things (IoT) and smart city solutions

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**AI in telecom, non-terrestrial networks, and telecom cybersecurity.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The India-UK Connectivity & Innovation Centre, inaugurated in October 2025, will focus on AI in telecom, non-terrestrial networks, and telecom cybersecurity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Centre is established to shape global standards in next-generation telecom, focusing on AI-driven optimization, satellite-based networks, and robust security frameworks.**
 
• **It aims to bring connectivity to remote areas through non-terrestrial networks (NTNs), and enhance telecom security with open standards and resilient protocols.**
 
• **The £24 million initiative over four years is a key component of the UK-India Technology Security Initiative, which focuses on the future of telecom and digital sovereignty.**
 
• **Industry partners like BT, Nokia, and Ericsson, along with academic institutions, will collaborate on research, trials, and commercialization, targeting global telecom standards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs)__

 __
 
• Network solutions using satellite, airborne, and hybrid architectures to provide high-speed connectivity to remote, rural, and underserved areas.
 
 
 
• Technology Security Initiative__
 __
 
• A collaborative effort between the UK and India to ensure digital security, innovation, and resilience in the telecom sector.
 
 
 
• UKRI and DoT__
 
 
• UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) and India’s Department of Telecommunications (DoT) are the implementing agencies for this strategic partnership.

questions.question: Which two cross-border rail links projects were agreed upon by India and Bhutan, with a total outlay of ₹4,033 crore?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kokrajhar-Gelephu and Banarhat-Samtse.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India and Bhutan have agreed to establish two cross-border rail links, Kokrajhar-Gelephu and Banarhat-Samtse, with a total cost of ₹4,033 crore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The rail projects will connect key cities in Bhutan, Gelephu and Samtse, with the Indian railway network starting at Kokrajhar and Banarhat.**
 
• **The Kokrajhar-Gelephu rail project spans 69 km, with an estimated cost of ₹3,456 crore, while the Banarhat-Samtse project will cost ₹577 crore for a 20 km stretch.**
 
• **India will provide the entire investment for these projects, marking the first rail connectivity initiative with Bhutan.**
 
• **The agreement stems from the MoU signed during Prime Minister Modi's visit to Bhutan, strengthening bilateral ties between the two countries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• India-Bhutan Relations__

 __
 
• India and Bhutan share deep cultural, civilizational, and developmental ties, with India being Bhutan’s top trading partner and largest provider of developmental assistance.
 
 
 
• Rail Connectivity Development__
 __
 
• This initiative aims to enhance infrastructure and economic cooperation between India and Bhutan, with rail connectivity playing a key role in strengthening bilateral relations.
 
 
 
• Foreign Secretary's Remarks__
 
 
• Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri emphasized the strong trust and mutual respect between India and Bhutan, rooted in shared developmental and security interests.

questions.question: Which tree was sent by King Charles III of the United Kingdom as a gift to the Indian Prime Minister on his 75th birthday?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadamb Tree**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **King Charles III of the United Kingdom sent a Burflower tree, commonly known as the Kadamb tree, to the Indian Prime Minister as a gift on his 75th birthday.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Kadamb tree is an evergreen, tropical tree native to South and Southeast Asia, known for its fragrant orange flowers that bloom in dense clusters.**
 
• **Historically, the Kadamb tree lent its name to the Kadamba dynasty, which ruled from Banavasi in Karnataka from 345 CE to 525 CE.**
 
• **The Kadamb tree was considered a holy tree by the Kadamba dynasty and served as the emblem of the Athmallik princely state during the British Raj.**
 
• **King Charles III's gesture reflects a symbolic connection between the UK and India, celebrating history and nature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kadamba Dynasty**__

 __
 
• The Kadamba dynasty ruled from Banavasi in Karnataka and played a significant role in the early history of the region.
 
 
 
• **Athmallik State Emblem**__
 __
 
• The Kadamba flower served as the emblem of the Athmallik princely state during the British Raj, symbolizing its cultural importance.
 
 
 
• **King Charles III's Gesture**__
 
 
• Sending the Kadamb tree as a gift reflects a thoughtful diplomatic gesture, strengthening the historical ties between the UK and India.

questions.question: On 26 October 2025, India’s INS Sutlej successfully completed a hydrographic survey covering 35,000 square nautical miles in cooperation with the Mauritius Hydrographic Service. How many joint hydrographic missions have India and Mauritius conducted so far, including this one?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**18.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **INS Sutlej successfully completed its 18th joint hydrographic mission with the Mauritius Hydrographic Service, surveying 35,000 square nautical miles of Mauritian waters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The INS Sutlej is equipped with advanced sensors and is part of the Indian Navy’s hydrographic fleet assisting Mauritius in maritime zone mapping.**
 
• **The mission involved training six Mauritian personnel in modern hydrographic techniques during the survey.**
 
• **The operation included joint EEZ surveillance and anti-piracy patrols in cooperation with the Mauritius National Coast Guard.**
 
• **The completed survey "fair-sheet" was handed over to Mauritian authorities in a formal ceremony with key officials from both nations present.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• India–Mauritius Maritime Cooperation__

 __
 
• India and Mauritius have been collaborating on hydrographic surveys since 2005 under a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU).
 
• The cooperation focuses on mapping maritime zones, hydrographic training, and enhancing maritime security.
 
 
 
• MAHASAGAR Vision__
 __
 
• The mission is part of India’s broader maritime vision MAHASAGAR, aimed at promoting security and growth across the Indian Ocean region.
 
• It complements the earlier SAGAR concept, enhancing regional security, collaboration, and economic growth through maritime cooperation.
 
 
 
• Strategic Recommendations__
 
 
• Proposes regular hydrographic surveys and the creation of a joint training and research center for marine sciences in the Indian Ocean region.
 
• Encourages leveraging autonomous marine vehicles, marine data analysis, and real-time maritime monitoring systems for enhanced collaboration and regional security.

questions.question: India and Mauritius signed an agreement to establish a satellite tracking station near which military base in the Chagos Archipelago?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Diego Garcia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and Mauritius Sign Agreement for Satellite Station Near Diego Garcia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
India and **Mauritius** have signed a historic agreement to establish a **satellite tracking** and **communication station** near the **US-UK military base** at **Diego Garcia** in the **Chagos Archipelago**.

 
 
• 
 
The agreement enhances India’s **strategic presence** in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**, countering **Chinese maritime activities**.

 
 
• 
 
India will use this station for satellite monitoring and data reception, bolstering its **geopolitical leverage** and **maritime security**.

 
 
• 
 
**PM Modi** termed the deal as a “**historic milestone**,” reaffirming support for **Mauritius’ sovereignty** over the **Chagos Islands**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Diego Garcia**: Located in the **Chagos Archipelago**, it hosts a significant **US-UK naval and air base**, playing a crucial role in military operations in **Iraq**, **Afghanistan**, and the **Gulf**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mauritius**: Established on **12 March 1968**, its capital is **Port Louis**, currency is **Mauritian Rupee (MUR)**, and its official languages include **English** and **French**.

 
 
• 
 
**Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**: A strategically important maritime region connecting **East Africa**, the **Middle East**, and **South Asia**, critical for global trade and security.
